recruiter.text: I am a performance-focused Senior Frontend Engineer with over 10 years of experience delivering high-value technical solutions for international clients. My track record includes doubling e-commerce revenue through strategic platform optimizations and leading complex legacy migrations for enterprise systems. I focus on accurate project planning and team efficiency to ensure business goals are consistently met.

developer.text: I specialize in modern web architecture, from migrating monoliths to Micro Frontends to building real-time AI agents with modern libraries and frameworks. My core stack relies on TypeScript, React and NestJS, supported by robust testing strategies using Playwright and Vitest. I am passionate about automating workflows and implementing BFF patterns to keep complex codebases scalable and maintainable.

friend.text: I have always been passionate about engineering. I started my career in retail sales and learned how to understand people. I went through the journey that taught me that honesty and soft skills are just as important as code. Whether I'm deploying software to a cloud server or fine-tuning local LLMs for my smart home, I love solving weird problems. I believe in learning by doing and always trying to help those around me succeed.

recruiter.text: I hold a Master of Computer Science and have spent a decade bridging the gap between technical execution and business requirements. My leadership style is defined by proactive mentorship and hiring, having successfully built and expanded engineering teams for multiple companies. I thrive in multicultural environments, translating complex technical challenges into clear solutions for stakeholders.

developer.text: My engineering philosophy centers on 'pixel-perfect' implementation and rigorous performance optimization, ensuring that the final product matches the design exactly. I believe in contributing to the community by reviewing code, documenting systems, and helping teams define better specs.

friend.text: I'm a curious builder who is fascinated by robotics and AI automation. When I'm not coding, I'm usually tinkering in my workshop. I use my leadership skills to organize hiking trips for my friends and family. I use my engineering vision to renovate my house to be as smart and efficient as possible. I value open communication and try to be the person who brings confidence and positivity to the people around me.

recruiter.text: I possess a comprehensive technical toolkit anchored in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with extensive experience in cloud DevOps using Azure and GitLab. I have successfully implemented cost-saving testing strategies and managed high-stakes integrations for banking and insurance sectors. Beyond code, I bring strong leadership capabilities, including team management and technical hiring.

developer.text: I live in the modern JavaScript ecosystem, utilizing React and NestJS for full-stack development and managing state with tools like Redux and Zustand. I prioritize reliability through end-to-end testing with Playwright, often mocking complex external services to ensure deterministic builds. My workflow is heavily optimized with CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, and strict TypeScript typing for backend-frontend contracts.

friend.text: I geek out on the latest tech, from training local LLMs to building custom smart home integrations. I care deeply about the details. Getting that CSS pixel-perfect and crafting elegant and efficient solutions is genuinely satisfying to me. I'm always happy to share what I know, whether it's helping you with a git merge or explaining how a car engine works.

recruiter.text: My career trajectory includes a Senior role at Mobiquity working on banking services and a Lead position at Erics Digital where I managed legacy migrations. At A-Dam, I delivered a web-shop platform that increased yearly revenue by over 100% and significantly boosted client retention. I consistently take ownership of full development cycles, from architectural design to final deployment and maintenance.

developer.text: At Mobiquity, I built complex chat interfaces to work with multi-agent BE systems, while at Erics Digital, I led the strangler-fig migration of an e-commerce monolith platform. I have experience solving unique constraints, such as building offline-first React Native apps and deploying web applications designed specifically for closed networks with thousands of users. I focus on creating reusable component libraries and stable architectures that allow teams to move faster.

friend.text: I've had some wild jobs, like building web systems for luxury ships or the app that KLM flight attendants use to take orders. My time at A-Dam was intense but rewarding, where we doubled revenue and I learned how to balance high-speed delivery with personal well-being. I love roles where I can take initiative, like when I led my first successful hiking trip and realized I enjoyed organizing chaos.

main_items.title: ChatAgent AI (Banking)

main_items.title: Bonfire Dating Platform
main_items.description: Led the frontend for a white-label dating app using an NX monorepo. Implemented Zod for validation, Axios interceptors for middleware routing, and SonarCloud for code quality.

main_items.title: Safety Notification System
main_items.description: Built a safety management dashboard for 6000+ employees. Implemented a BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) strategy to streamline API responses and managed Azure DevOps pipelines.

main_items.title: Erics WebShop Migration
main_items.description: Migrated a legacy WebSphere monolith to a headless React architecture. Improved SEO scores (Lighthouse) and implemented a custom translation tool with Localise.

main_items.title: A-Dam E-commerce
main_items.description: Forked and customized the Saleor.io platform to drive 100% revenue growth. Optimized Apollo caching to handle high-traffic events like Black Friday.

recruiter.text: I recently engineered a Banking AI Chat UI that utilized cost-effective testing strategies to save significant project budget. For the Dating Platform, I delivered critical user onboarding features and middleware that streamlined user routing based on complex business logic. At A-Dam, my e-commerce solution successfully handled bulk B2B purchases and drove a 150% increase in marketing campaign revenue.

developer.text: The AI Chat project involved integrating multi-agent configuration in LangChain and building a tool to help the model provide complex data structures to visualize account information. For the Dating Platform, I implemented Axios interceptors for intelligent middleware routing and migrated the entire routing stack to React Router v7. My work on the Erics Digital migration involved reverse-engineering legacy modules to rebuild them into a modern hybrid Micro Frontend architecture with React.

friend.text: I'm really proud of my progress in the development of ideas that I have had for a very long time. With AI tools available it became clear that code is just a tool to make things faster. I have started to work on a solution to analyze my emails with local AI. Another one for suggesting trading strategies and recommendations on products to trade using a mix of remote/local agents. But the best so far - is this portfolio website. Simple, fast and specially designed personal story to help me, and you, to find each other.
